importantNotes: The Christ Hymn (2:5-11) is one of the highest Christological passages in the NT.
'To live is Christ, to die is gain' (1:21) — Paul's fearless perspective on life and death.
'Rejoice' or 'joy' appears 16 times — remarkable from a man in prison.
'I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me' (4:13) — often misquoted out of context.
Philippi was the first church Paul planted in Europe (Acts 16).

chapters.1: Paul's gratitude and prayer; to live is Christ, to die is gain; advance of the gospel in prison.
chapters.2: The mind of Christ — humility and obedience; the Christ Hymn; Timothy and Epaphroditus.
chapters.3: Knowing Christ surpasses everything; pressing on toward the goal; citizens of heaven.
chapters.4: Rejoice always; do not be anxious; think on excellent things; contentment in all circumstances.
